name: change-practice
description: Single, multi-persona organisational change management practice — setup interview, change definition, stakeholder and impact analysis, change risks, sponsor health check, strategy and measurement plan, sponsor and stakeholder engagement, champion network, communications (draft-never-send), training needs, business readiness and go/no-go review, resistance, go-live transition, portfolio saturation, adoption, reinforcement, BAU handover, lessons learned, weekly status, meeting prep and stakeholder pulse. Five personas over one shared change record in docs/change/. People change only — not IT change control.
